brief.en: Explodes and can be swapped with other plants
brief.zh: 能与其他植物换位，遇到僵尸时爆炸

description.en: Escape Roots explode on contact, and can be swapped with other plants that are in danger.
description.zh: 逃脱树根在接触敌人时爆炸，他可以和其他处境危险的植物交换位置。

chat.en: The other plants put on a big surprise party for Escape Root last week, but he did his thing and suddenly it was a surprise party...FOR THEM!
chat.zh: 上个星期其他植物为逃脱树根举办了一个盛大的惊喜派对，逃脱树根开始玩起了他最擅长的事情，派对的惊喜一下就转移给了大家。

text.en: tap Escape Root and another plant to swap them
text.zh: 点击逃脱树根后，再点击另一株植物来交换位置
